package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/personalteacher"
)

type ensurePersonalTeacher interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type updatePersonalTeacher interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, input personalteacher.UpdateInput) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

type ensureTeacherSoul interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error)
}

type updateTeacherSoul interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, input personalteacher.UpdateSoulInput) (domain.TeacherSoul, error)
}

// PersonalTeacherHandler serves the authenticated student's logical teacher.
type PersonalTeacherHandler struct {
	EnsureUC     ensurePersonalTeacher
	UpdateUC     updatePersonalTeacher
	SoulUC       ensureTeacherSoul
	SoulUpdateUC updateTeacherSoul
}

type updateRequest struct {
	ExpectedVersion    int64   `json:"expected_version"`
	TeacherProfileID   *string `json:"teacher_profile_id"`
	Language           *string `json:"language"`
	CommunicationStyle *string `json:"communication_style"`
	PedagogyProfile    *string `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	HintPolicy         *string `json:"hint_policy"`
	InterventionMode   *string `json:"intervention_mode"`
}

type updateSoulRequest struct {
	ExpectedVersion    int64   `json:"expected_version"`
	DisplayName        *string `json:"display_name"`
	PersonaCode        *string `json:"persona_code"`
	VoiceStyle         *string `json:"voice_style"`
	RelationshipStyle  *string `json:"relationship_style"`
	EncouragementStyle *string `json:"encouragement_style"`
}

// GetMe ensures and returns the student's PersonalTeacher.
func (handler PersonalTeacherHandler) GetMe(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	teacher, err := handler.EnsureUC.Execute(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to load personal teacher")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teacher)
}

// UpdateMe applies a versioned partial settings update.
func (handler PersonalTeacherHandler) UpdateMe(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	var request updateRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 16<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "request body must contain one JSON object")
		return
	}
	teacher, err := handler.UpdateUC.Execute(r.Context(), personalteacher.UpdateInput{
		StudentID:          studentID,
		ExpectedVersion:    request.ExpectedVersion,
		TeacherProfileID:   request.TeacherProfileID,
		Language:           request.Language,
		CommunicationStyle: request.CommunicationStyle,
		PedagogyProfile:    request.PedagogyProfile,
		HintPolicy:         request.HintPolicy,
		InterventionMode:   request.InterventionMode,
	})
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, teacher)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrVersionConflict):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, err.Error())
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
	}
}

// GetMySoul ensures and returns the soul owned only by this student's logical
// PersonalTeacher.
func (handler PersonalTeacherHandler) GetMySoul(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	soul, err := handler.SoulUC.Execute(r.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to load teacher soul")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, soul)
}

// UpdateMySoul applies an independently versioned partial soul update.
func (handler PersonalTeacherHandler) UpdateMySoul(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		writeError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized")
		return
	}
	var request updateSoulRequest
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 16<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid request body")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "request body must contain one JSON object")
		return
	}
	soul, err := handler.SoulUpdateUC.Execute(r.Context(), personalteacher.UpdateSoulInput{
		StudentID: studentID, ExpectedVersion: request.ExpectedVersion,
		DisplayName: request.DisplayName, PersonaCode: request.PersonaCode,
		VoiceStyle: request.VoiceStyle, RelationshipStyle: request.RelationshipStyle,
		EncouragementStyle: request.EncouragementStyle,
	})
	switch {
	case err == nil:
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, soul)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherSoulNotFound):
		writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrVersionConflict):
		writeError(w, http.StatusConflict, err.Error())
	default:
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err.Error())
	}
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{"error": message})
}
